item.title: Mixed-Media Marketing Works Because Humans Don’t Live on One Platform
item.description: If you’ve ever heard a song on the radio, saw the same artist on TikTok, then later noticed them on YouTube or a streaming TV ad break… you’ve experienced mixed-media marketing the way it’s supposed to work.
